observations.title: Action, reusable prompt and checklist
observations.description: Task is an action for Codex; Prompt stores a request that a reader can open in chat; Checklist represents checkable items. Do not equate a generated tracker with a scheduled task.
observations.acceptance: Verify execution confirmation, stored state and manual completion separately.

observations.title: Inherited access and reparenting
observations.description: A subpage inherits access from its parent or space. Removing a direct invitation does not remove inherited access. Moving a page requires edit access to both and can alter readers.
observations.acceptance: Verify direct/inherited access, preview before move and revocation.

observations.title: Locked chat file visibility
observations.description: Files saved from locked chats are hidden from Space and available only in their originating chat until unlocked; separately linked files retain original access.
observations.acceptance: Check source access without surfacing protected content in search.

observations.title: Typed template versus generic artifact
observations.description: Seven named templates correspond to purpose-specific editors. Generic interactive tools can also be created from chat, but are not a separately named eighth template in the guide.
observations.acceptance: Test creation path, editor identity, availability and export per type.

observations.title: Batched edit requests across Markdown files
observations.description: When Claude drafts multiple Markdown files, edit requests can be queued across files; the file list indicates waiting requests, then one message applies the batch.
observations.acceptance: Test per-file pending requests, submit, errors, partial application and undo.

observations.title: Agent template creates separate copy
observations.description: A template shares reusable configuration rather than conversations, computer state or logins. Publishing and updating template, importing a new copy and sharing one live Bot are distinct.
observations.acceptance: Test copied identity, permission, update and unpublish semantics.

observations.title: Source labels and grouping
observations.description: With five or more sources, automatic labeling may organize them by topic; users may rename, add, remove labels and move sources.
observations.acceptance: Test threshold, manual relabel, selection and unchanged source identity.

observations.title: View saved generation prompt
observations.description: Artifact menu exposes customization prompts for supported types, with viewer shortcut for some study outputs.
observations.acceptance: Verify original prompt, permissions, reuse and distinction from current output.

observations.title: Export snapshot and citation sheets
observations.description: Data table exports use separate data and citation tabs in Sheets; report tables may use individual tabs. Exported changes do not sync back and notebook permissions are not carried over.
observations.acceptance: Test export, source attribution, new identity, independent permissions and edits.

visual_evidence.label: Agent comment anchored to selected text
visual_evidence.description: Promotional composite showing highlighted text with agent name tag, comment card, reply input, resolve/checkmark and reaction/overflow icons. Does not establish live cursor, animation or permissions.
